title: The Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and differential transcendence of prime-counting series: a Lean 4 formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of a meromorphic Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and its applications to differential transcendence. The prime-indicator series and the generating function of the prime-counting sequence each satisfy no algebraic differential equation over C(q), proving the prime-counting part of Pak’s Conjecture 2.5. The quantitative prime number theorem input is discharged using the MediumPNT theorem from the PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) project by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors, together with a transfer to the prime-counting function. Version 1.1.1 adds explicit fresh leanchecker kernel replay for all PNTIntegration modules in CI and prominent PNT+ attribution. The theorem for the logarithmic reciprocal series sum over n ≥ 2 of q^n/log(n) is also included. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with the investigation, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization. Independent specialist review is welcome.
